description: Register one new prompt template (Pro+ only). name + version + template are required; variables / labels / description are optional. An existing (name, version) pair returns 409 (UNIQUE constraint). Used when an AI agent auto-registers templates for evals / experiments.

labels.description: Array of labels (up to 8, each [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}). E.g. ['production', 'staging'].

template.description: Prompt body (non-empty, up to 50000 chars). {{var}} placeholders are filled from variables.

variables.description: Default values for {{var}} placeholders in the template (plain object, 4096 bytes max after JSON serialization). Optional.

name: create_prompt
